articles.title: Is having urine the color of Mountain Dew normal?
articles.summary: A Trump administration doctor says neon yellow urine is normal because of diets consisting entirely of meat and fermented foods. Here’s what experts say. A doctor who advises several Trump cabinet members on their diets rhapsodized this summer about having urine the color of Mountain Dew, thanks to…
body: What you consume does determine what you see in the toilet. But should urine be neon yellow – or some other hue? Here’s what you need to know.

Urine is normally a shade of yellow owing to a pigment called urobilin, which your gut bacteria produce. The more diluted it is by extra fluid intake, the lighter its shade – so urine is typically darker in the morning or when you’re dehydrated.

You may have seen charts that indicate what color and shade urine “should” be, but “they are considered imprecise” and experts don’t rely on them for serious purposes such as managing kidney disease, says Suzanne Watnick, a nephrologist at the University of Washington. Urine’s darkness or lightness loosely corresponds with hydration status, but for most people, it’s best to rely on your sense of thirst rather than what’s in the toilet to determine when to drink water.
That said, in people who need to stay highly hydrated, urine shade can be a helpful hydration indicator. For example, people prone to kidney stones should aim for very pale urine, Watnick says.

articles.title: 11 Foods To Increase Your Ferritin Levels
articles.summary: The best foods to help increase your ferritin levels are foods that are rich in iron. Here, the experts break down everything you need to know.
body: If you’ve been diagnosed with iron deficiency by a medical professional, you’re probably familiar with ferritin. But even then, though the two are connected, they aren’t interchangeable, as many are led to believe. “Ferritin is different [than iron that most people are familiar with],” integrative nutritionist and psychologist Karishma Shah tells Vogue. “It is your storage form of iron.”

“Think of it as your iron savings account,” adds Real Nutrition founder Amy Shapiro, RD. “When a doctor measures serum ferritin, they're getting a snapshot of how much iron you have in reserve. Low ferritin is often the first sign that iron stores are running low, sometimes long before anemia shows up. That's why people can feel tired, foggy, cold, or notice hair shedding even when their hemoglobin looks normal.”
So what’s the fix? Should you find that you may be dealing with an iron deficiency, one of the easiest ways to treat it is through your diet.

articles.title: Matthew McConaughey has read all his bad reviews – and I applaud him | Polly Hudson
articles.summary: The Hollywood actor revealed he once read two-decades’ worth of pans in one fell swoop, during two days in the desert. It’s the kind of preposterous self-flagellation we can all learn from and enjoy.
body: T o assume makes an ass out of you and me, but as sweeping generalisations go, this seems fairly uncontroversial: nobody likes hearing themselves being criticised. Obviously there are exceptions to the rule – no kink shaming here – but most people aren’t fans.
Which is why a recent admission from Matthew McConaughey is unusual. The Hollywood actor revealed that he once spent two days in the desert reading 20 years’ worth of negative reviews about himself.

I love everything about this. Each detail is perfect: the setting, the duration of the pursuit and the period spanned by the reviews, the narcissistic/anti-narcissistic intent, the ridiculousness, the pretension, the commitment.

“I read every one,” McConaughey said on the podcast Build or Break, while wearing tinted sunglasses inside and the sort of hat last seen on The Only Way Is Essex. “I sat with them – I spent two days looking. It was hard.”

articles.title: ‘Whimsical witch stuff’ and vintage radio shows: how horror novelists celebrate Halloween
articles.summary: Four horror novelists – Riley Sager, Leah Rowan, Rachel Harrison and Grady Hendrix – share advice for embracing Halloween, even if you’re a scaredy cat. What do the best Halloween costumes all have in common? Sign up for the Filter US newsletter, your weekly guide to buying fewer, better things.
body: In October, horror lovers can finally rejoice in the season’s endless supply of spooky films, haunted houses and macabre decor.
Others prefer to bask in the comforting glow of the TV while enjoying their 70th rewatch of Hocus Pocus (which arguably is scarier than you might think).

No matter what camp you fall into, you can still enjoy October, or “spooky season” as millennials call it. So I asked the most qualified people I could think of – horror novelists – how to enjoy the season.

“We don’t need to love Freddy and Jason to love horror. It’s a very broad spectrum,” said Rachel Harrison, bestselling author of the witchy novel Cackle and the haunting read, Play Nice. Riley Sager, author of The Unknown and Home Before Dark, suggests a low-key alternative: spooky vintage radio shows. “They are not terrifying. They’re just chilling,” he said. (His recommendations include Three Keleton Key and Sorry Wrong Number.) They also shared how they celebrate the season and, perhaps most importantly, their favorite Halloween candy.

articles.title: This Walmart Sister Chain Has the Most Impressive Thanksgiving Meal for Cheap
articles.summary: I have always helped my mom in the kitchen during Thanksgiving, but I’ve never hosted the holiday by myself. This year I’m spearheading a 21-person Friendsgiving in New York City. So far it’s been fun to plan the menu and the weekend, but it’s also been stressful.
body: If that’s also a stress for you, look no further than Sam’s Club. This year, the grocery chain is launching a meal kit that can serve up to 16 people for just $160 dollars and can be prepared in less than two hours. That means you could save both money and time with this deal. Here’s what you need to know.

Last week, Sam’s Club announced its 2026 Thanksgiving meal kit based on “nearly a year of member feedback.” It is the grocer’s biggest Thanksgiving kit yet, and it comes in at a little under $160 — so you can serve 16 people for less than $10 a person.

The Thanksgiving meal kit will become available on October 28, and members can add the item to their carts and actually customize it to add or remove dishes as they please. I think the item I would be most excited about is the charcuterie tray. I love a cheese board, but they definitely can add up when you’re buying all the aged cheeses and meats. This tray could be the difference between a hungry, hovering family member and a patient, seated guest. I also love that the kit comes with two portions of the green beans, mac and cheese, and pumpkin pies. Sides and desserts are some of my family’s favorite items.

articles.title: How ‘La Bola Negra’’s Costume and Production Designers Crafted Its Sensuous Universe
articles.summary: “La Bola Negra” is Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi’s most ambitious work to date. So, too, is it a major achievement for their collaborators Ana Cobos and Roger Bellés.
body: After nearly a decade of making visionary, queer-centric work, Spanish filmmakers Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi, known together as Los Javis, have reached dizzying new heights with La Bola Negra, inspired by the life and work of Spanish poet and playwright Federico García Lorca.

The film centers on Sebastián (singer Guitarricadelafuente), Carlos (Milo Quifes), and Alberto (Carlos González)—three gay men living in 1932, 1937, and 2017, respectively—who are connected by one of Lorca’s unfinished plays, La Bola Negra. Blending historical narrative, fiction, and fantasy as it explores how shame and resilience can be a kind of inheritance, the hyper-stylized epic is Calvo and Ambrossi’s most ambitious work to date. So, too, is it a major achievement for Los Javis’ collaborators Ana Cobos, La Bola Negra ’s costume designer, and Roger Bellés, who headed production design.

articles.title: The 2-Minute Trick for the Easiest Chicken Pot Pie of Your Life
articles.summary: Pot pie is one of those cozy fall dinners that I look forward to all year. It’s got everything: hearty filling with protein and veg, savory sauce, and a tender, buttery lid.
body: I don’t know about you, but I can’t remember the last time I went to that much trouble. I usually opt instead to skip the bottom crust altogether, and, more often than not, the top crust as well. Instead I turn to any number of quicker, less labor-intensive options like biscuits, crescent roll dough, or drop biscuits. A quick stir-together biscuit dough doesn’t require any rolling, folding, and shaping, and store-bought dough is an even easier way to streamline this dish. But both still require some level of advanced planning.
I recently found the perfect solution for the non-planners like me: buttered toast.

While reading through Colu Henry’s newest cookbook, Better At Home, I found my perfect “I didn’t get to the store” pot pie topper: slices of buttered bread. Buttered bread hits all the notes I’m looking for on top of a pot pie: It’s bready to soak up the flavors of the sauce, it’s buttery, and once it’s toasted in the oven, it adds a textural contrast to what is otherwise a pretty soft dish. It’s perfect.

articles.title: Dakota Johnson and Machine Gun Kelly Make Their Daytime Debut
articles.summary: In a rare joint sighting in Los Angeles, the rumored couple kept things low-key, with Johnson delivering another masterclass in effortless off-duty dressing.
body: Dakota Johnson and Machine Gun Kelly’s rumored romance has been kept relatively under wraps, and their latest outing is just as low-key on the fashion front. The pair were spotted leaving a studio in Los Angeles, each offering a different take on off-duty dressing.

Johnson, ever the purveyor of effortless and considered basics, stayed firmly within her tried-and-tested wardrobe territory. The actor wore a long black leather coat over a simple black tank, paired with straight-leg blue jeans cinched with a leather belt. A gray knit was draped nonchalantly over her shoulders, while black sunglasses, layered silver necklaces, and a pair of black velvet ballet flats from The Row completed the look. Her signature blunt bangs were present and correct.

articles.title: A "Plain Box" Is Now a Blue Adventure-Themed Bedroom
articles.summary: Two guiding principles led to the design of 3-year-old Leo’s bedroom for Los Angeles-based interior designer and documentary filmmaker Reilly Dowd. For starters, she wanted to prove that “a room with no beautiful ‘features’ to begin with could be the most magical space in the house.” Secondly…
body: “My whole belief is that a child is a person with a worldview, not a theme — so I made him a real room, with the same design integrity as the rest of the house, built to grow up alongside him,” Reilly explains. “Leo’s nursery had a gentle circus-and-hot-air-balloon idea and was more restrained; this room is the grown-up evolution of that, designed a little beyond his current age so he grows into it rather than out of it.”

When Reilly set out to design this bedroom, she says there wasn’t a lot going on in it. It was only 9 by 11 feet, lacked natural light, and looked like “a kind of plain box people would just push furniture into,” she says.

Reilly took Leo to the paint store, where she laid out six shades of blue, and he selected Farrow & Ball’s “Cook’s Blue” (a color she’d loved for many years before this project). From there, he helped where he could, including painting the walls blue, campaigning for glossy red woodwork, and serving as the curator of what does and doesn’t belong on his shelves — it changes daily.
“A child who feels like he built his room lives in it completely differently than one handed a finished one,” Reilly says.

articles.title: Costco’s New Viral Food Court Dessert Tastes Like My All-Time Favorite Apple Pie
articles.summary: It’s hard to pin down exactly what groceries makes Costco the best. The $1.50 hot dogs are a real draw, but so are the deals on bulk groceries across its sprawling freezer, pantry, and deli sections. In fact, I’ve had Costco birthday cakes for more years than I can count.
body: The Apple Pie Sundae is latest Costco food court is here for a limited time this fall. It’s $2.99 and comes in a 12-ounce plastic cup (as large as the everyday sundaes and smoothies). It features layers of vanilla soft serve ice cream, apple pie filling, and cinnamon-sprinkled pie crust crumbles.

If you love Costco’s apple pie, you will really love this sundae. It tastes like apple pie a la mode. Who doesn’t love a slice of their favorite fall fruit pie topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream? Here, the creamy vanilla ice cream dominates, with chunks of buttery apple pie crust and apple filling mixed in.
The generous layers of pie crust and apple pie filling is what really takes this sundae to the next level. It’s sweet, jammy, and crunchy from the pie bits — it’s a textural wonderland.

The only change I’d make is to somehow heat the pie filling. Maybe Costco can upgrade it to a hot Apple Pie Sundae next year. In the meantime, this is a great seasonal treat at any temperature. Swing by your Costco’s food court, try it for yourself, and let me know what you think.

articles.title: Where to Stay When Visiting Alaska's Denali National Park
articles.summary: The best hotels, lodges, and cabins for a trip to the Last Frontier.
body: With broad river valleys, colorful meadows peppered with fireweed and lupine, forests thick with spruce and aspen, and the snow-covered Alaska Range rising in the distance, Denali National Park and Preserve is one of those places that can still feel startlingly wild no matter how many times you visit. At 6.1 million acres, it’s larger than Massachusetts, and the sheer scale of the national park means a trip here can look very different depending on where you choose to stay.

I’ve selected the best stays across that spectrum, from full-service hotels and family-friendly cabins to secluded backcountry lodges and even a chalet set on a glacier just miles from the summit of North America’s highest peak. Read on for my favorite places to stay near Denali National Park in Alaska.

articles.title: Easy, Bakery-Worthy Brioche
articles.summary: The mixer does all the heavy lifting. READ MORE...
body: Editor’s note: If you’ve cooked this beloved recipe before, it might look a little different these days! We recently improved it with more streamlined guided instructions to make it even easier to follow and more delicious.

Brioche is a foundational bread. It’s wonderful on its own, light and fluffy with just a hint of sweetness. It’s also the perfect building block for dishes like bread pudding and French toast (not to mention its more indulgent variant, French toast casserole ).

Brioche dough can also be used to make light and buttery rolls for burgers, chicken sandwiches, and lobster rolls. It’s a real do-it-all kind of bread — the kind that can pop up at every meal, but whose elevated flavor and texture make it more special than your average loaf.

I learned to make brioche from a pastry chef at a small specialty bakery using an industrial mixer that was almost as big as I was. Making brioche at home is not nearly so intimidating. The stand mixer does all the hard work. All you need is to look for a few specific cues (like waiting until one pat of butter is mixed in before adding another) and your whole kitchen will be smelling like freshly baked bread in no time.
